name: ai-chat
description: Open-source, self-hostable AI chat platform: real-time agent conversations over WebSockets, a durable queue pipeline and an admin dashboard.

scripts.build: npm run build -w sdk/js && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w dashboard
scripts.build:dashboard: npm run build -w sdk/js && npm run build -w dashboard
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w sdk/js
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w sdk/js && npm run typecheck -w dashboard
